title: Design doesn't let you get under anything
text: Design doesn't let you get under anything. It has great suction but is hard for an old lady to push except in the rooms with thinner carpet.  The rollers do get wrapped in longer dog hair.  I had to cut it out after one room because the light turned to red indicating the roller was not turning.  I had run a vacuum just two days prior so it wasn't that bad.  With the canister placement so far forward you can't get under anything.  I really like my Shark Rocket but this one is questionable.

product_metadata.title: Shark Navigator Powered Lift-Away Upright Vacuum, NV586
description: A 2-in-1 Powered Lift-Away upright vacuum with a detachable canister for portable cleaning. With the touch of a button, Powered Lift-Away technology allows you to lift the canister away and deep-clean hard-to-reach areas while still delivering power to keep the brushroll spinning. Equipped with Advanced Swivel Steering and powerful LED headlights, this vacuum has a completely sealed system with a HEPA filter to trap dust and allergens. The fingertip controls allow you to easily switch between hard floor and carpet mode, and the Pet Multi-Tool is a combination hard bristle brush and upholstery tool, perfect for removing embedded pet hair.
